    """

                continue
            if item['score'] == last_score and item['id'] <= last_id:
                continue
        start = i + 1
        break

    page = ordered[start:start + size]
    
    # Build next cursor if there are more items
    next_cursor = None

import pytest
from pages import list_page

# Test data with ties in score
def test_basic_pagination():
    """Test basic pagination with cursor."""
    items = [
        {'score': 10, 'id': 'a'},
        {'score': 10, 'id': 'b'},
        {'score': 5, 'id': 'c'},
        {'score': 5, 'id': 'd'},
        {'score': 3, 'id': 'e'},
    ]
    
    # First page
    page1, next1 = list_page(items, None, 2)
    assert page1 == [{'score': 10, 'id': 'a'}, {'score': 10, 'id': 'b'}]
    assert next1 == '10:b'
    
    # Second page
    page2, next2 = list_page(items, next1, 2)
    assert page2 == [{'score': 5, 'id': 'c'}, {'score': 5, 'id': 'd'}]
    assert next2 == '5:d'
    
    # Third page
    page3, next3 = list_page(items, next2, 2)
    assert page3 == [{'score': 3, 'id': 'e'}]
    assert next3 is None
    
    # Verify all items returned exactly once
    all_items = []
    cursor = None
    while True:
        page, next_cursor = list_page(items, cursor, 2)
        all_items.extend(page)
        if next_cursor is None:
            break
        cursor = next_cursor
    
    assert len(all_items) == len(items)
    assert all_items == items

    """Test that malformed cursor raises ValueError."""
    items = [{'score': 10, 'id': 'a'}]

    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        list_page(items, 'no_colon', 2)

    """Test that size < 1 raises ValueError."""

        list_page(items, None, -1)
